title.en: SSH into a VPS, audit resources, and optimize RAM
title.es: Conectar por SSH a un VPS, auditar recursos y optimizar RAM

description.en: Connect to an Ubuntu VPS over SSH, inventory OS/RAM/disk, disable unused services, and deliver a TXT report of resources after optimization.
description.es: Conéctate por SSH a un VPS Ubuntu, inventaria SO/RAM/disco, desactiva servicios inútiles y entrega un informe TXT de recursos tras la optimización.

delivery.instructions: Share a GitHub repository URL that contains resources-after.txt with free -h / df -h after optimization and a ready statement for the CTO.
